Hi, I’m Jane — a certified Personal Trainer, a competitive Bikini
Athlete, and the coach behind every program here.


I started coaching online because I was tired of watching women spend
years — and thousands of dollars — on programs that were never
built for them. PDFs, generic apps, ten-week templates … none of it
accounts for _your_ body, _your_ schedule, or _your_ life.


What you get with me is the opposite. A real coach. A program built
around you. Daily access, weekly check-ins, and the kind of
accountability that actually moves the needle.


- **Certified** Personal Trainer
- **Competitive** Bikini Athlete

JaneCoach & founder

[Apply to work with me →](https://janeflores.com/#apply)

- 01

  ### Daily In-App Support


  Message me directly any day of the week — questions, form check videos, last-minute swaps, life curveballs. You’re never sitting on it for a week.

- 02

  ### Weekly Strategy Check-Ins


  Every week we look at the data — training, nutrition, sleep, stress — and adjust. Nothing on autopilot, nothing left to guess.

- 03

  ### Truly Personalised Plans


  Built around your equipment, your schedule, your body, your goals. Re-built as you progress — not recycled from someone else’s template.

- 04

  ### Form Feedback & Video Review


  Send a quick lift video, get notes back. Cleaner technique, better results, fewer injuries. The detail your gym PT can’t give you online.

- 05

  ### Mindset & Accountability


  The plan is the easy part. I help you with the bit nobody else does — the consistency, the spirals, the weeks where life gets in the way.

- 06

  ### Built for Real Life


  Travel, kids, shift work, comp prep, busy seasons — the program flexes with you. No all-or-nothing thinking, ever.

### ✓ This is for you if…

- You’re ready to commit to at least 12 weeks of consistent work.
- You want a real coach — not a chatbot, not a recycled PDF.
- You train (or want to train) 3–5 times a week.
- You’re open to nutrition guidance and weekly accountability.
- You value structure, but want a plan that flexes with real life.
- You’re prepping for a comp, or want to train at that standard.

### ✗ This isn’t for you if…

- You’re looking for a 30-day quick fix or a crash diet.
- You want a generic PDF — cheaper options exist for that.
- You’re not willing to check in honestly each week.
- You’re looking for “motivation” rather than a plan and accountability.
- You’re not ready to invest in yourself, financially or otherwise.

How much does coaching cost?

Coaching is a premium service and is priced accordingly. Investment starts from $295/month for ongoing coaching, with a recommended minimum 12-week commitment. Comp-prep packages are quoted individually based on stage timeline. I’ll discuss exact pricing on our strategy call — no surprises, no upsells.

I’m a complete beginner. Is this still for me?

Absolutely — in fact, beginners often see the fastest progress because everything is built from the ground up. You won’t be thrown into anything you’re not ready for. Your first program is calibrated to where you actually are right now, with full video demos and form notes for every exercise.

I don’t have a gym. Will this still work?

Yes. Tell me what you have access to — full gym, garage setup, dumbbells at home, hotel room — and I’ll programme around it. I’ve coached women through everything from elite gyms to suitcase travel-only routines. You don’t need fancy equipment to make real progress.

How is this different from an app like Sweat or Kayla?

Apps like Sweat give you a generic plan that millions of women run at the same time. There’s no person on the other end. With me you get a programme designed specifically for your body, your goals, and your life — plus a real coach you can message daily. It’s a different category of service.

How fast will I see results?

Most clients feel different in 2–3 weeks (energy, strength, sleep), and start seeing physical changes by week 6–8. Real, lasting transformation — the kind you can sustain — takes 12–16 weeks of consistent work. I will never promise overnight results, because they don’t exist and they don’t last.

What if I miss a week or fall off?

You won’t be judged for it — that’s the whole point of having a coach. Life happens. We adjust the plan, regroup, and keep moving. The all-or-nothing mindset is what’s kept you stuck before. We don’t do that here.

How often will we actually talk?

As often as you need. Daily messaging is included — ask me a question Tuesday morning, you’ll usually have a reply within a few hours. We also have a structured video check-in every week. Most clients message me 2–5 times a week, on top of weekly check-ins.

Can I cancel any time?

Yes. After your initial 12-week commitment, coaching rolls month to month and you can cancel any time with 14 days’ notice. I’d much rather you stay because it’s working than feel locked in.

I’m thinking about competing — can you prep me?

Yes — this is a particular specialty. I’ve prepped women from absolute first-stage to multiple-show seasoned competitors. We’ll build the timeline backwards from your show date, layer in posing, peak week, and post-show reverse so you don’t blow up after the stage.
